title: EmortalMC
description: A minigames server powered by Minestom
body:
# EmortalMC
EmortalMC is an [open source](https://github.com/emortalmc) minigames server powered by [Minestom](https://github.com/minestom/minestom). Minestom is an open source alternative server software that can use significantly less resources than Spigot or Paper.


## Gamemodes:

### BlockSumo
Chaotic PVP minigame where you have 5 lives and the only way to eliminate other players is with the void

### Parkour Tag
Start as a tagger or a runner, tag all other players or survive until the time runs out!

### Minesweeper
Endless version of Minesweeper in Minecraft

### Console Edition Battle
A remake of the nostalgic console edition survival games mode 

### LazerTag
A PVP shooter, where you are given random guns each kill and race to 25 kills

### Marathon 
An endless, randomly generated parkour gamemode where you gain score each jump. Features a highscore leaderboard system to compete with friends and other players!
